title: Malaysia Just Gave AI To 600,000 Students!
description:
Malaysia just gave 600,000 public university students access to Google Gemini for Education! 🇲🇾 Over 128,000 students now have premium AI research tools that turn weeks of reading into minutes. Is this the future of education? Malaysia is building an AI economy by teaching the next generation how to learn faster, think deeper, and build real things.

What do you think about AI in schools? Let me know in the comments! 👇

#Malaysia #GoogleGemini #AI #ArtificialIntelligence #StudentHacks #EdTech #MalaysiaTech #StudyTips #FutureOfWork
